title: UI Rollout Telescope — Standup Notes
body:
Meeting: UI Rollout Telescope — weekly standup capture
Date: 2026-11-02
Attendees: Aisha (notes), Tom, Maya, Rajesh, Sofia, +1 (floating)
Duration: 30m (standing)
Location: #console-tooling on Slack / Zoom

Purpose: quick cross-cut between UI, rollout infra, and analytics to surface anything blocking the A/B push and to check telemetry health before tomorrow's staggered release.

---
TL;DR
- Canary for panel-experiments v4 is green at 95% traffic slice; p50 latency stable but p95 has a small bump after morning deploy (see metrics).
- Analytics pipeline backlog: ingestion lag spikes seen for 20m at 06:15 UTC — root cause likely kafka consumer rebalance after a worker OOM.
- Two small frontend regressions: (1) suggestion dropdown flicker on low-end GPUs (CSS repaint), (2) feature-flagged fallback not honoring session pinning.
- Action: Rollout pause threshold increased to 7% error window; apply quick patch for session pinning before expanding canary.

---
Notes by area

UI (Maya)
- Today: fixed dropdown flicker repro and landed a defensive style patch (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/462). Patch reduces repaints by swapping complex transform for opacity.
- Observed: dropdown flicker only reproducible when client-side rendering falls back to CPU (low-spec device); not a server API regression.
- Next: add a lightweight QA test to Puppeteer suite to hit the low-spec emulation (Maya -> ticket: CTOOL-1297).
- Blocking? Not blocking rollout, but want the fix in canary-2 before full ramp.
- Note-to-self: follow up with design on z-index stacking context for nested panels — may simplify future fixes.

Rollouts / Canary (Tom)
- Canary status: 3/4 waves complete. Wave 3 at 30% traffic shows small error spike (0.9% -> 3.4%) for requests touching panel gating logic.
- Root cause hypothesis: race in the new panel gating cache invalidation logic (see linked CONFLUENCE:CI-UI-PANELS-45). Repro locally with stress harness.
- Mitigation: apply temporary catch-all guard in routing layer to fall back to stable gating (hotfix branch: rollout-fallback-2026-11-02).
- Decision: pause expansion to 50% until hotfix rolled and validated in canary-3. Expected roll-forward window: 2 hours.
- Action owner: Tom to deploy hotfix and monitor for 60m. If stable, resume stagger at +1h.

Analytics / Telemetry (Rajesh)
- Ingestion: short-lived lag spike 06:15-06:35 UTC — consumer group rebalance after kafka worker crashed (OOM). Data backfilled, but alerting threshold increased because late events impacted live dashboards.
- Query perf: p95 dashboard query time from 820ms to 1.1s when ingestion lag present.
- Logs: found increased volume of noisy WARNs from the metrics-extractor related to unescaped user attrs; will land escaping patch. (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console-metrics/pull/118)
- Next: add durable consumer config and OOM bounds for workers (prod ops ticket: CTOOL-1301).
- Blocking? Need infra approval for permanent memory bump; temporary restart applied.

SRE / Observability (Sofia)
- Alerts: new rollout-signal alert threshold tuned — reduce flapping by adding a 3m evaluation window instead of immediate trigger.
- Traces: correlation between error spike and a 50ms increase in cache miss rate for the gating service — tracing points to slight change in KV TTL policy in the most recent runtime.
- Action: coordinate with serving-runtime team to revert TTL tweak for this service only as experiment (SLO impact negligible).

---
Action items (owners & due dates)
- Tom: deploy rollout-fallback-2026-11-02 hotfix to canary-3 and validate (due: 2026-11-02 12:30 UTC).
- Maya: add Puppeteer low-spec test + open CTOOL-1297 (due: 2026-11-04).
- Rajesh: implement consumer OOM guard and open infra PR for memory bump (CTOOL-1301) (due: 2026-11-03).
- Sofia: adjust alert evaluation window and add runbook note (done: draft runbook in CONFLUENCE:CI-UI-PANELS-45) (due: 2026-11-03).
- Aisha: draft release note snippet and update rollout checklist about session pinning edge-case (due: 2026-11-02 EOD).

Open questions / discussion items
- Should we revert the KV TTL change globally or only for the gating service? Sofia suggests scoped revert to reduce blast radius. Decision deferred until hotfix validation.
- Do we need a circuit-breaker on the client for dropdown rendering to avoid user-visible flicker? Maya: lightweight CSS fallback + telemetry to measure prevalence first.

Quick wins / follow-ups
- Add a lightweight client metric to count session pinning misses (Rajesh + Maya).
- Short-term: add an ingest alert that flags backfill volume > 5% of baseline to catch late spikes earlier.

Misc notes / raw captures (informal)
- "notes to self" — double-check that A/B config TTL is not tied to CDN cache headers; saw weird mismatch in dev env.
- Slack refs: #console-tooling thread "panel-gating-rolling" (link: slack.com/archives/C0X12345/p167...), thread has initial race repro.
- Git refs: local stress harness in console-ui/test/rollout-stress.sh is flaky on mac; use linux CI runner for consistent repros.

Meeting wrap / next sync
- Re-sync tomorrow 06:00 UTC if hotfix applied; otherwise ad-hoc channel updates.
- If hotfix fails, prepare rollback playbook (Tom/Sofia) and open emergency meeting.

End notes: capture placed here for traceability; will push a cleaned summary to Confluence after hotfix validation.
